title: BUR to Brickell
body: Flew BUR–DEN–MIA and checked into AC Hotel Brickell for a few nights on the bay.

title: Dinner on the water
body: First Miami dinner at Crazy About You.

title: Big Bus day
body: A Big Bus ticket around Miami — an easy way to see the city before we boarded.

title: Key West
body: A day trip down to Key West, then back to Brickell.

title: Miami to Miami
body: Boarded Virgin Voyages Brilliant Lady for eleven nights — Southern Caribbean & Aruban Nights. The meals that stuck: The Test Kitchen and Pink Agave. A Shore Thing in Ocho Rios.

title: One night ashore
body: Off the Lady and overnight at Travel Inn Riviera Beach, between ships.

title: Nassau on Paradise
body: Margaritaville at Sea Paradise from Port of Palm Beach — a three-night Nassau run.

title: West to LAX
body: Trip’s end. Home to LAX after Nassau.
